name: The Vents
summary:
The Vents.  Be sure to join the discord ---> https://discord.gg/QjJZsuaRRd 

This is a gorilla tag fan game much like various other games. In this game, the map is a unique style, you will have to navigate through the vents without being caught by the many monsters that have taken residency in the vents! A amazing staff team with active applications.
